source_table: abstract (SAGE full text returned HTTP 403 and was not fetched)
notes: [hydrocephalus] grade_provisional. THE MOST IMPORTANT NEGATIVE ROW IN THIS LANE AND ALSO THE WEAKEST - READ THE CAVEAT. This is the largest published survey of neurological findings after intrathecal ASO dosing in non-human primates (28 studies, 1,016 animals). The five sign categories the authors report are: (1) non-adverse transient absence of lower spinal reflexes, dose-related, resolving by 24-48 h; (2) adverse muscle tremor/spasticity during or immediately after injection (one third responded to diazepam, two thirds required euthanasia); (3) ataxia, paresis, nystagmus, urinary incontinence or tremor 30 min to 4 h after dosing; (4) rapidly progressing hind-limb paralysis from spinal cord injury, with MRI-confirmed focal spinal cord necrosis; (5) rare adverse hind-limb paresis or paralysis 2-18 days after dosing. Hydrocephalus, ventriculomegaly and raised intracranial pressure are absent from all five. CAVEAT THAT MUST NOT BE DROPPED: this is a survey of CLINICAL NEUROLOGICAL SIGNS, not of ventricular imaging or morphometry. The paper does not state that ventricular size was measured, and a monkey with mild ventriculomegaly would very likely show no clinical sign at all. readout_value '0_of_1016' therefore means 'no hydrocephalus reported among the clinical signs in 1,016 animals', NOT 'ventricular size was measured in 1,016 animals and found normal'. Treat as weak negative evidence only. Only the abstract was retrievable.
